title: The Distant Band
label: ch:bn-distant-band
canDo: I can retrieve, with nothing uncovered, the words and letters this book taught between ninety-eight and a hundred and four lessons ago — and I can tell the difference between a word I have lost and a word I now know to go back for.

payoff.summary: Four chapter-closing practice lessons, untouched for the length of a whole book, are answered in one sitting; nothing in the chapter is new, and that is the measurement.
